predictions: After that pretty crappy week 3, I bounced back in a big way last week! Posted a big old 20-3 record last week, with two of those matches either flipping result or tying on a single dart. And two of the three I actually noted as super timid picks, so even I knew those were dicey. That good week takes me to 68-24 (73.9% correct) for the season. Imagine what I could achieve if I didn't have to pick F division matches (9-7 total), or more specifically, Bangin or Rippin matches (combined 1-7 so far!!).

Match of the week: (E Div.) Death Throw @ Red-eye Rangers. The Rangers started off way too slowly in week 4, and ended up falling from the ranks of the unbeatens. That's the only blemish on the records in this showdown of two of D's top trio. So how the heck do both teams have losing SCkt records?! I guess I will take Death Throw here, but I will be honest that no E team is exciting me a lot right now. DT, 13-11.

Match #2: (F Div.) Runs with Corks @ Dart Side of the Moon. Dart Side somehow got thumped by Bangin in week 3, or else this also could have been an undefeated showdown. They sure did get a big win last week though… but then again, so did the Corkers (see page 1 story). In the end, if feels like the Corkers have something cooking. Cork, 14-10.

Match #3: (B Div.) Raging Bulls Eyes @ Dart Attack. Darty Minds pulled out a 501 Houdini act, so these two aren't tied for the B lead (at least yet). But they ARE still the next two, and this head-to-head battle could determine who is in line to fight for the B title. Both teams feature a couple serious guns, and this is a great matchup. Let's go Attack, 13-11.

Match #4: (C Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Darty Sanchez. Bandits just took one on the chin from the other of C's top three, and now they get the second half of this rough double-header. And while it feels like the Bandits have had the stronger results so far, the stats sort of lean a bit toward Sanchez. I'm feeling really torn here. Ummm… Sanchez, 13-11.

Match #5: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ DD-214. D division has a four-pack of 1-loss teams leading the way, and two of them get together right here. I had certainly been on the DD train at the start of the season, but for some reason I'm kinda feeling Menace lately. Menace, 14-10.

Matches #6 & #7: (A Div.) Ring of Elements @ Liver Alliance; The Bullies @ Lunatic Fringe. The marquee matchup in the RDL is often the Element-Bullies showdown to cap the end of each half of the season. But for that pairing to really mean something, they both have to get past some serious hurdle weeks. And here we go with another serious hurdle week! Pay attention or fall in the span of a blink. Element and Bullies both handle business, by 16-8 and 17-7.

Match #8: (B Div.) Trips Are For Kids @ Show Me Your Tips. Three B teams above 0.500. Three B teams below 0.500. And these two at exactly 0.500 and possibly determining which end of the B race is in their futures. Looking like Show Me in a close one, 14-10.

Match #9: (A Div.) Put It on Matt's Tab @ Consist. Inconsistent. Somebody is about to pick up win #1 for the season. Given that Inconsistent has already posted 11 points against both Fringe and Liver, how could I possibly pick against them?? CI it shall be, 15-9.

Match #10: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Killer Dee's. Two undefeated teams lead G, but these two are waiting to pass whichever of those two slips up. Some strong showings from these two, but we have to go with the ironman We Throw It squad, 14-10.

Matches #11 & #12: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ Sofa Kings; Liquor Posse @ Banging The Wire. Similar situation to match #8 above, but here in F, there are FOUR teams in the middle at 0.500. And they face off in two potentially-season-defining matchups here. These are sooo even, and I (literally) never get a Bangin pick right. I guess we will roll with Sofa, 14-10; and then doom Bangin, 13-11.

Match #13: (G Div.) Triple Shot @ The Rock Bottoms. Alright, it's not just "that match," but also one that guarantees us another first- time winner. Let's go with a win for the newcomer Triple Shot, 13-11.
And the remaining 10 matches, sorted by division:
B Division: Darty Minds 15, Icemen's 9; Uber Out 13, Trippin 11.
C Division: Outlaws 13, Rif Raf 9; Nine Lives 14, Off Constantly 10.
D Division: Cheap Shots 14, McGavin 10; Reload 14, Duckas 10.
E Division: Sharky's Machine 15, Irish Ton 9; Ton 80 16, YNTA 8.
F Division: Rippin Darts 13, That's What She Said 11.
G Division: The Neighborhood Dart Knights 17, 21 Dart Salute 7.
